create_BatchedFrequencyPenalizer: create a batched frequency penalizer that penalizes tokens based on their output frequency
test_is_required: test the BatchedFrequencyPenalizer _is_required method to check if frequency penalty is non-zero
build_prepare: build the BatchedFrequencyPenalizer _prepare method to initialize frequency penalty tensors
run_cumulate_output_tokens: run the BatchedFrequencyPenalizer _cumulate_output_tokens method to accumulate token frequency penalties
apply_logits: apply the BatchedFrequencyPenalizer _apply method to subtract cumulative penalties from logits
